title: [BUG] CLI-only "API Error: Rate limit reached" on every request despite 97% quota remaining (Max 20x plan)
body: ## Preflight Checklist - [x] I have searched existing issues - [x] This is a single bug report - [x] I am using the latest version of Claude Code ## What's Wrong? Claude Code CLI returns "API Error: Rate limit reached" on EVERY request for 24+ hours. claude.ai web and Claude Desktop work perfectly on the same account. Only CLI is affected. ## Environment - Platform: macOS - Versions tested: v2.1.49, v2.1.50, v2.1.51 - Plan: Max 20x ($200/month) - Account: km78cho@gmail.com - Auth: claude.ai (firstParty), no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set ## Account Status - Session: 3-7% used - Weekly: 0-1% used ## Troubleshooting Done - Logout/login, deleted ~/.claude, re-authenticated - Tested 3 CLI versions - Removed plugins and MCP configs - New project directories - Upgraded Max 5x → Max 20x - Disabled extra usage after $53/$53 exhaustion ## Root Cause Extra usage exhausted ($53/$53) → disabled → CLI rate limit flag stuck server-side. Plan upgrade did not reset it. ## Support Tickets (no human response) - 215473191468894 - 215473197028578 - 215473205020751 ## Related Issues #25531 #25778 #27008 #25733
author: silverte

**Same issue here — with a clear reproduction trigger.**

- **Plan**: Claude Max
- **Claude Code**: v2.1.55, Opus 4.6 (1M context)
- **OS**: macOS (Darwin 25.3.0)
